notes: Identity verified from cover: Evaluating the replicability of social science experiments in Nature and Science between 2010 and 2015; Colin F. Camerer, Anna Dreber, Felix Holzmeister and the listed coauthors; DOI 10.1038/s41562-018-0399-z. Document is the authors’ Supplementary Information (methods, references, Tables 1–7, Figures 1–9), not an abstract or secondary report. No source PDF supplied. Target mapped by author/year and Table 1 hypothesis, not study-number equivalence or numeric matching. Only assigned unfinished fields completed; other fields are placeholders. Final outcome uses Stage 1 when replication stopped there and pooled Stage 1+2 when reported (two-stage procedure, p. 15). Authors explicitly mark Rep. as 'no' for this named study in the pooled Stage 1+2 results. This is their tabulated replication verdict, not a verdict inferred from p. The broad neutral description mentions classroom performance, but supplied study 1 and p. S11 identify the high-pressure laboratory test in Table 1 (p. 50); no classroom-test statistic is substituted.
